85ffd46b4a: Genoryn Krypton is one piece of open-source software in four programs: a wallet, a full node, a miner and a command-line wallet. Together they let you hold, send, mine and trade GNR without asking anyone's permission and without trusting anyone's word. These pages say what the software does, how, and where its limits are.

57d7a2650e: Six things it is built to do well
c050c8f720: A full node checks every block and every proof against every rule, so no miner, exchange or website can make you accept GNR that breaks them. The light wallet checks the proof of work behind what it is told.
7b000247d0: Sender, recipient and amount of every transfer are hidden by a zero-knowledge proof. See exactly what the chain shows, what a node can learn about you, and what stays public on purpose.
8cf721a922: Spending is a hash-based zk-STARK proof and payment data is encrypted with ML-KEM, NIST's post-quantum standard. Nothing that guards coins or privacy can be broken by Shor's algorithm.
ee04ef75db: The light wallet runs on an ordinary computer and needs no chain download. A full node needs about 0.5 GB of disk today. Mining wants a graphics card, and works on a processor.
386289a5b4: A desktop wallet with a built-in miner, swap board and console; a command-line wallet; a node with a REST API, JSON-RPC and a WebSocket; SDKs for TypeScript, Rust and C.
d8cf7aa2c0: Every full node carries blocks and transactions to others over links encrypted against quantum computers, and makes the network harder to split, censor or lie to.
b89ec3d9cc: Any number of wallets, private payments, payment proofs, the miner, atomic swaps with bitcoin on the offer board, live network charts, a read-only console, signed updates. Verifies what nodes tell it; can run its own node with one switch.
5922adfbf3: Downloads the whole chain and checks every rule. Relays blocks, transactions and mining shares. Serves an API on this computer for wallets, miners and your own programs.
b183651ece: KryptoHash on NVIDIA (CUDA), AMD and Intel (OpenCL) graphics cards and on processors. Paid in proportion to its work, with no pool.
bac73959d4: The same wallet without a window, for servers and scripts.
1b29541d3b: Everything is in one package for Windows and for Linux, signed with the project's post-quantum release key. See <0>Download</0>.
f7adf48d94: Every block's reward goes into a pool that consensus holds, and every share a miner finds earns an equal slice of it. One percent of the hashrate earns about one percent of the rewards, alone, from the first hour.
02ced7899c: BTC and GNR change hands in atomic swaps between two wallets: either both sides are paid or neither is. A sell offer must prove its GNR to the board before it is listed.
8f4d221980: A payment proof shows one payment, its amount, memo and recipient, to whoever you give it to, and nothing else about your wallet. Anyone can check it on the explorer.
abe8f33a25: The wallet is free, open source and needs no account. Your keys are made on your computer and never leave it.
2f1bc41fbb: What Genoryn Krypton (GNR) gives you: full validation of every rule, payments that are private by default, cryptography a quantum computer does not break, a wallet with a console, and a node that helps the network.
